verdict.rationale: The evidence says Sai is "model-agnostic" and lets you choose the planning model, and that it can run on your own device (BYOD). Neither states that a locally hosted model is supported or that device control works without a cloud API. Running on a local device is not the same as running a local model, and model choice may still mean cloud models only, so this support is adjacent rather than direct.

support.subject: As a power user, the agent runs with a local model, so device control does not depend on a cloud API
